summary: Frontend E2E testing of Projects & Time Tracking feature. Encountered 2 blocking bugs which I fixed to unblock testing: (1) Next.js Server Actions rejected all form posts because x-forwarded-host != origin (ingress uses two different preview hostnames). Fixed by adding experimental.serverActions.allowedOrigins to next.config.ts. (2) /projects/new was reusing the [id]/edit page handler and tried to read params.id (undefined for static route), throwing a drizzle query error. Fixed by making params optional and treating undefined id as isNew. After fixes, 10 of 12 requested scenarios pass. Remaining issue: 'Τιμολόγηση μη χρεωμένων' action does not actually create an invoice or update statuses (dialog confirms but nothing changes).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking 'Τιμολόγηση μη χρεωμένων' and confirming the browser confirm dialog does NOT create an invoice, does NOT redirect to /invoices/<id>, and time-entry/expense statuses stay 'Καταχωρημένο' instead of becoming 'Τιμολογημένο'. Μη χρεωμένα stat remains €90.00. Dialog message 'Δημιουργία τιμολογίου με σύνολο περίπου 90,00 €' is shown so the client handler runs; the server action `invoiceUnbilled` in src/app/actions/projects.ts appears to fail silently or its redirect is lost.

integration_issues.issue: The initial start-timer click did start a timer server-side (verified on next page load: elapsed 00:00:58 counter + 'Τρέχει' row appears with Στοπ button). However in the same JS session the UI did not swap start-timer-btn → stop-timer-btn quickly enough for the test to click stop. May be a router.refresh() / revalidation delay after the server action returns. Manual retest after page reload confirms the running-timer UI works.

action_items: Fix invoiceUnbilled server action: verify it actually inserts an invoice row, links project time entries + expenses to it, updates their status to invoiced, and redirects to /invoices/<newId>. Check server logs when clicking; the client dialog confirms but no navigation happens.
Investigate router.refresh() / revalidatePath after startTimer so the UI immediately reflects the running state (currently only reflected after a full navigation).

Keep the next.config.ts experimental.serverActions.allowedOrigins entry — without it, every server action (login, create project, log time, add expense, start/stop timer, invoice) returns 500 'Invalid Server Actions request' because the ingress sets x-forwarded-host=cashflow-pro-295.preview.emergentagent.com while the browser Origin is the cluster hostname.
Keep the /projects/new page fix — the previous version crashed with a drizzle 'params: ,<orgId>,1' error whenever the route was hit.
critical_code_review_comments: src/app/(app)/projects/new/page.tsx was written expecting a dynamic [id] param but placed at a static /projects/new route. The [id]/edit page then re-exports it. If the shared-handler pattern is kept, add explicit optional typing for params and default id to 'new' (as I did) — otherwise Next.js will always pass empty params and drizzle will throw.

Next.js production/preview deployments behind a reverse proxy that rewrites Host must have experimental.serverActions.allowedOrigins configured with every hostname the browser might use, or all server-action POSTs will 500.
invoiceUnbilled server action needs proper error surfacing — currently the failure is completely silent to the user (no toast, no error banner, dialog just closes).
seed_data_creation: One project 'Test Project Alpha' (id 015ec060-51bd-404b-a544-5c95f12d45ca) with 1 task 'Analysis', 1 time entry (1.5h, €75), 1 project expense 'Metro tickets' (€15) was created in the demo org SQLite DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login uses Next.js Server Actions — must have serverActions.allowedOrigins set in next.config.ts. Handle browser confirm() dialogs BEFORE clicking the trigger via page.on('dialog', ...). Existing test project id in DB: 015ec060-51bd-404b-a544-5c95f12d45ca. Scenarios still to re-verify after main agent fixes invoiceUnbilled: (a) redirect to /invoices/<id>, (b) invoice has 2 lines (time + expense), (c) time/expense statuses flip to 'Τιμολογημένο'.
rca of the issue: Bug 1 (login 500) — Next.js 15/16 protects server actions by comparing Origin vs x-forwarded-host; the emergent ingress rewrites x-forwarded-host to *.preview.emergentagent.com while the browser origin is *.cluster-7.preview.emergentcf.cloud, so every action was rejected with 'Invalid Server Actions request'. Fix: whitelist both hostnames in experimental.serverActions.allowedOrigins. Bug 2 (/projects/new crash) — /projects/new is a static route with no dynamic segment, but its page.tsx destructures params.id and passes it to a drizzle eq(projects.id, id) query. id is undefined → drizzle throws → error boundary shows 'Κάτι πήγε στραβά'. Fix: make params optional and treat missing id as isNew. Bug 3 (invoiceUnbilled silent) — need to inspect server logs and the action implementation; likely either the action throws (invalid data) or its redirect() is being caught by an outer try/catch (Next.js 15 uses a throw to redirect).
